(()=>{const r=__shellReview,m=r.motion,$=id=>document.getElementById(id);let n=performance.now();const tick=c=>{for(let i=0;i<c;i++)m.update(n+=50);};m.reset();$('closed').click();const camera=r.camera.position.toArray();const old=m.inspect().activeId;m.reload();tick(30);m.reset();if(m.inspect().activeId!==old||m.inspect().spareId)throw Error('cancel replacement');$('clay').click();m.reload();tick(120);$('clay').click();const cell=r.interior.modules.find(x=>x.id==='cell').group;const installed=cell.children.find(o=>o.name.startsWith('replacement cartridge'));if(!installed||installed.children.some(o=>o.isMesh&&o.material.color.getHex()===0xb6bcb8))throw Error('grey replacement');m.reset();$('auto').click();tick(440);if(!m.state.auto)throw Error('auto lost');if(r.camera.position.toArray().some((v,i)=>Math.abs(v-camera[i])>1e-7))throw Error('auto camera');m.reset();$('side').click();m.reload();tick(20);m.state.paused=true;return {cancelReload:true,greyReplacement:true,twoAutoCycles:true,camera:true,overflow:document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth};})()
